description: Lines whose geometry is built from OpenStreetMap by scripts/routes/osm-route.js (run by .github/workflows/route-geometry.yml). Waypoints are visited in order; `station` names are looked up on the line. `preferName` is a case-insensitive regex for way names/operators to prefer. `replace: true` replaces the line's existing hand-drawn route.

routes.note: Port Morris Junction to Scranton: the 1911 Lackawanna Cut-Off (Port Morris - Slateford Junction, incl. Roseville Tunnel, Pequest Fill, Paulins Kill and Delaware River viaducts) then the former DL&W main line over the Poconos. Hoboken - Port Morris is traced along the existing NJ Transit Morris & Essex track by fill-gaps.js.
